shared_elements: frontal anthropomorphic figure carved in low relief on an upright block
head or face with headdress/headband at top
concentric circle / disc motifs on the torso area
arms rendered in shallow relief flanking the body
belt or horizontal band across the lower torso
schematic linear glyph-like or emblem-like elements on the chest
vertical banded elements framing the head
justification: Both surfaces depict a frontal, blocky anthropomorphic being carved in very low relief on a tall vertical mass, with a broad headdress or framed head at the top, chest ornaments including concentric-circle discs, low-relief arms folded toward the centre, and a horizontal belt/band crossing the lower torso — a distinctive and consistent scheme rather than a generic figure. The clearest difference is that A's relief is flatter and more crowded with rectilinear glyph-like panels while B has a more sculptural, three-dimensional head and clearer bilateral body outline, and B's lower body carries additional emblem motifs absent in A.
